description: Check a Sui transaction before signing it: tide simulates it, explains what it would do in plain words, and checks every recipient, coin and package against full history. Returns safe, caution or danger with findings and evidence links. Block on danger. Pass tx_bytes (base64 TransactionData, or TransactionKind bytes with sender). Example: { tx_bytes: "AAAC..." }.

sender.description: The signer. Required with TransactionKind bytes; with TransactionData it runs the check as this address.

tx_bytes.description: The unsigned transaction as base64: TransactionData, or TransactionKind bytes with sender.

name: explain_unsigned
title: Check a transaction before signing
